description: This Java class provides utility methods for converting IPv4 addresses to long format, converting long to dotted format, checking if an IP is in a range, and determining if the application runs on a local machine.

classes.name: IPv4Helper
classes.description: A utility class for IPv4 address conversions and range checks, including detection of local machine IP.

methods.name: ipAddressToLong
methods.description: Converts a dotted IPv4 address string to its long integer representation.

methods.name: longToIpAddress
methods.description: Converts a long integer back to a dotted IPv4 address string.

methods.name: ipAddressIsInRange
methods.description: Checks if a given IP address falls within a specified range.

methods.name: applicationIsRunningOnLocalMachine
methods.description: Determines if the application is running on the local machine based on IP address.

methods.name: applicationIsNotRunningOnLocalMachine
methods.description: Checks if the application is not running on the local machine.
